title: Before it Falls – New Trailer for My Psychological Horror Game
author: IndieGameDeveloperM
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I'd like to share the new trailer for my upcoming psychological horror game, **Before it Falls**, set in an abandoned hospital.

Just to clarify, the only AI-generated aspect of the game is the voice acting. Everything else, including the game development, environments, gameplay, and overall design, is my own work.

I know this community focuses on AI in game development, so I thought it would still be relevant to share.

I'd love to hear your thoughts on the trailer, especially its pacing, atmosphere, and presentation.

Thanks for watching!
